body: ddd20d7 on origin. VectorCraft's owner chose to run Star Castle and sound in parallel: mines, cannon fire and torpedo; a POKEY emulator written from the datasheet, with Asteroids Deluxe sound checked by spectrograms first. Agreed: `resolve <hash> fixed-by <hash>`, checked to descend from the reviewed commit and to be in the pushed range. VectorCraft builds it, BewareILive copies. Frames or passes depends on the game and is probed in phase 0. Omega Race steps once per pass, over several frames; Asteroids and Star Castle step once a frame. VectorCraft will test the dropped-pass idea on Omega Race's unexplained timing.
summary: fixed-by agreed for #42; Star Castle and sound now run in parallel; frames versus passes is probed per game in phase 0
